text: Sorry, that was my mistake. When I started, the chat watcher showed me old messages from the last two days that nobody had marked as read, and I answered each one as if it were new. The replies to your newest messages (SX/Polymarket coverage, the 21 Odds API keys) are the ones that matter; ignore the rest. The old requests are still open in the task list, so nothing is lost, and I won't reply to old messages like that again.
